9-PANEL STYLE REFERENCE for children's book 'My Shadow Ran Away'

VISUAL STYLE: Golden Hour Silhouette - warm sunset palette, soft watercolor washes, bold black silhouettes for shadows. Nostalgic summer evening light.

Row 1 - CHARACTER SUNNY:
[1] Sunny standing: Girl (5) with wild curly brown hair, yellow sundress, bare feet. Hands on hips, determined look. Golden afternoon light bathes her. Her shadow stretches long beside her.
[2] Sunny running: Same girl mid-stride, arms pumping, hair bouncing. Chasing something. Warm orange light. Dynamic pose.
[3] Sunny kneeling: Gentle expression, arms open welcoming. Soft pink sunset light on her face. Caring, relieved.

Row 2 - CHARACTER SHADOW:
[4] Shadow standing: Bold black silhouette figure on golden grass. Simple but expressive - you can see attitude in the pose. Hands on hips mimicking Sunny.
[5] Shadow playful: Same black silhouette but stretched tall and thin, arms up in joy, clearly having fun. Mischievous energy.
[6] Shadow scared: Silhouette becoming faint and wispy, hunched over, reaching out. Translucent edges showing it's fading.

Row 3 - SETTINGS & COLOR:
[7] Golden afternoon: Grassy yard, big oak tree, picket fence. Sun high, warm yellow light, long shadows on grass.
[8] Sunset pond: Small pond with reeds, water reflecting orange and pink sky. Ripples, scattered ducks.
[9] Deep sunset: Big orange sun on horizon, sky in bands of gold, orange, pink, purple. Silhouettes of trees. Magic hour.

STYLE: Soft watercolor washes, warm nostalgic palette, bold black silhouettes. NO TEXT.

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover together. Ask: What do you think is happening? Why would a shadow run away? Have you ever noticed your shadow doing funny things?
parent_tips.during_reading: Help with 'shadow' and 'away' - these are heart words we learn as wholes. Sound out words like: sun, sat, ran, fun, big, hid, hop, dog, got, dip, wet, sad.
parent_tips.after_reading: Go outside and play with shadows! What happens to your shadow when the sun is high? When it's low? Can you make your shadow do funny poses?
